metadata.description: Import every firmware binary found under /data/samples into the akiba instance. The corpus is a homogeneous set of ARM:LE:32:v8T raw binaries: every entry of the list names that arch, so each binary is imported with one language instead of being tried against the 18 candidates in ProgramManager.GUESSED_PRIMARY_LEVEL_ARCHES, and the arch the import records is what the later stages read back. Run as: ./bin/akiba_framework -c /data/pipelines/00_import.json@/main -i /data/pipelines/generated/import_list.json
